name: Colma Creek
intro: Creek level and rain at Orange Memorial Park in South San Francisco, and the Bay tide at Alameda. Thresholds are for the community downstream of Orange Memorial Park.
note: Flood Monitoring = potential for 50% channel capacity exceedance downstream; Flood Watch = 75%; Flood Warning = 100% (flooding likely).

name: San Bruno Creek
intro: Creek level at First Avenue in South San Francisco / San Bruno, rain in the upper and lower watershed, and the Bay tide at Alameda. The creek at First Avenue rises and falls with the tide.

name: Belmont Creek
intro: Creek level at Old County Road, rain at Old County Road, and the Bay tide at Redwood City. Thresholds are for the Harbor Industrial Area community downstream of the Caltrain crossing. Flooding is likely if 30-minute rain exceeds 0.20 inches, or if 4-hour rain exceeds 0.42 inches and the tide is high.
note: Flood Monitoring = potential for 50% channel capacity exceedance downstream; Flood Watch = 75%; Flood Warning = 100% (flooding likely).

name: Atherton Channel
intro: Channel levels at Alameda de las Pulgas and just upstream of the Caltrain crossing, rain at Caltrain, and the Bay tide at Redwood City. Thresholds are for the community downstream of the Caltrain crossing.
note: Flood Monitoring = potential for 50% channel capacity exceedance downstream; Flood Watch = 75%; Flood Warning = 100% (flooding likely).
